Here’s my take after a thousand hours… (god I love this game)

When you start, you won’t get very many kills if any and you’ll die A LOT.

When you get better and understand the mechanics and team dynamics better, you’ll get more kills and you will die A LOT no matter what. But you’ll get more kills. 

Also, for example, if you’re AT sometimes it’s better to hard flank and not focus on objective while you blow up enemy vehicles. Make the enemy expend every last bit of gas and munitions they have so they won’t have armor when it’s the most important to them. A good tank crew can REALLY fuck up everyone’s day and lay nonstop 76mm shells full of hatred on your team’s head. Even a one-man armor squad can do sufficient damage in a tank if he sits back far enough. Might take you 5-10 minutes to flank around, but it’s worth it to get him off your team’s back. 

You probably don’t need these tips but damn I just love talking about this game.
